$comment_plan: qb-rating SFDMU data plan - usage definitions (units, usage resources, usage policies) and the product-to-resource links (ProductUsageResource). The policies and grants on each link load from qb-rating-entitlements, which runs next.
$comment_pass1: Pass 1: Upsert every object. Objects with a Status (UnitOfMeasureClass, UsageResource, ProductUsageResource) use skipExistingRecords: new rows are inserted as Draft and existing rows are never touched, so a reload of a built org changes nothing and never demotes an Active record. Nothing is deleted (todo 298).
$comment_pass2: Pass 2: Update the same three objects WITHOUT Status, so a correction to any other field of an existing row still lands on a reload. activateRatingRecords.apex activates (Draft -> Active) after qb-rating-entitlements loads.
$comment_260: API 260+ notes: QB-DB;QB-TOKEN (Token PUR for Anchor product) is required before QB-DB Usage PURs can activate. Token-backed and currency-backed usage PURs (UR-*-TKN, UR-*-MTY) use dedicated UsageResource records with TokenResourceId set at the UsageResource level; the pre-populate + clear+activate pattern in activateRatingRecords.apex handles activation.
$comment_extraction: SOQL queries include relationship traversal fields (e.g., Product.StockKeepingUnit, UsageResource.Code) so this plan works for both import (CSV > org) and extraction (org > CSV). SFDMU v5 does NOT write $$ composite-key columns during extraction; the ExtractSFDMUData task runs scripts/post_process_extraction.py to add/normalize those $$ columns so extraction outputs are re-import-ready. Always use the post-processed extraction output when re-importing.

objectSets.name: First Pass - Upsert; insert missing rows as Draft, skip existing

objects.query: SELECT ConversionFactor, CurrencyIsoCode, Description, Name, RoundingMethod, Scale, Sequence, Status, Type, UnitCode, UnitOfMeasureClassId, UnitOfMeasureClass.Code FROM UnitOfMeasure ORDER BY UnitCode ASC

objects.$comment: Pass 1 inserts missing rows as Draft and skips existing ones (skipExistingRecords), so a reload never sends Status=Draft to an Active row. Pass 2 corrects the other fields; activateRatingRecords.apex activates (todo 298).
objects.query: SELECT Code, BaseUnitOfMeasureId, BaseUnitOfMeasure.UnitCode, DefaultUnitOfMeasureId, DefaultUnitOfMeasure.UnitCode, Description, Name, Status, Type FROM UnitOfMeasureClass ORDER BY Code ASC
SELECT Code, Name, Status, UsageAccumulationMethod, UsageAccumulationPeriod FROM UsageResourceBillingPolicy ORDER BY Code ASC

objects.$comment: Pass 1 inserts missing rows as Draft and skips existing ones (skipExistingRecords), so a reload never sends Status=Draft to an Active row. Pass 2 corrects the other fields; activateRatingRecords.apex activates (todo 298).
objects.query: SELECT Category, Code, Description, Name, UsageDefinitionProductId, UsageDefinitionProduct.StockKeepingUnit, Status, TokenResourceId, TokenResource.Code, UnitOfMeasureClassId, UnitOfMeasureClass.Code, DefaultUnitOfMeasureId, DefaultUnitOfMeasure.UnitCode FROM UsageResource ORDER BY Code ASC
SELECT Name, ProductCode, StockKeepingUnit, UsageModelType FROM Product2 ORDER BY StockKeepingUnit ASC
SELECT Code, Name, IsRenewalAllowed, RenewalFrequency, RenewalFrequencyUnit, Status FROM UsageGrantRenewalPolicy ORDER BY Code ASC
SELECT ShouldAllowRolloverExpiry, Code, MaximumRolloverCount, Name, IsRolloverAllowed, Status FROM UsageGrantRolloverPolicy ORDER BY Code ASC

objects.$comment: Pass 1 inserts missing PURs as Draft and never touches an existing one (skipExistingRecords), so a reload neither deletes nor re-sends Status to Active records (the platform rejects Active->Draft on PUR). Pass 2 corrects the other fields of existing PURs. Matching on the traversal key works on the 5.6.4+ floor. TokenResource is set by activateRatingRecords.apex (clear+activate), not by this plan, so pass 2 leaves it out. Policies and grants on each PUR load from qb-rating-entitlements, which runs next (todo 298).
objects.query: SELECT EffectiveEndDate, EffectiveStartDate, IsOptional, ProductId, Product.StockKeepingUnit, Status, TokenResourceId, TokenResource.Code, UsageResourceId, UsageResource.Code FROM ProductUsageResource ORDER BY Product.StockKeepingUnit ASC, UsageResource.Code ASC
SELECT GrantBindingTargetType, GrantBindingType, Product2Id, Product2.StockKeepingUnit, Name FROM UsagePrdGrantBindingPolicy ORDER BY Product2.StockKeepingUnit ASC, Name ASC
SELECT Name, RatingDelayDuration, RatingPeriod FROM RatingFrequencyPolicy

objectSets.name: Second Pass - Update existing rows, without Status

objects.$comment: Readonly in pass 2 so the Update rows below can resolve their lookups (UnitOfMeasureClass base/default unit, UsageResource default unit, the Product lookups). A lookup whose parent object is not declared in the pass is sent as null: without these, pass 2 blanked UnitOfMeasureClass.BaseUnitOfMeasure/DefaultUnitOfMeasure on a built org.
